name: Sentient Depths
detailed_description:
Sentient Depths is a dungeon-crawler-like, set in a Fantasy World. A long time ago the gods were imprisoned in magical crystals. Without their presence and protection, dark forces and corruption took over the world.

In this sinister world, Elfrir sets out on a mission to better the life of his younger sister. With that motivation he attempts to join the Order of the Lotus, who have preserved knowledge about the prisons of the gods and how to free them.

Since Elfrir doesn’t hold anything to his name but the clothes he wears, he has to master a challenge. Just for the chance to join the Order as a squire he has to clear out a dungeon on his own. He is provided with a simple sword and some basic training before he is sent into the Depths.

Fight your way through the dungeon and help Elfrir to join the Order of the Lotus! Clash with melee, ranged and defensive Golems, which have been attracted by the power of the imprisoned god.

Level up and strengthen your Health and Aura or improve your abilities. Aside from your normal attacks you also have a special attack available. You can try to defend yourself with a parry or dash through the attacks of your enemies. Clear the whole dungeon and reach the final room to help make the world a better place.

short_description: In Sentient Depths you step into the shoes of Elfrir, a squire-aspirant to the Order of the Lotus. You follow him into dungeon after dungeon to free the gods from their magical prisons and fight side by side with them to rid the world of evil beings.
